_comment: Sample $attrs for the generic Tableau priorisé (rankedTableCard) card, in the RankedTableAction OUTPUT shape (columns[] + rows[].cells[], flattened). The agent supplies a JSON `spec` (columns + keyed rows) to Get_Ranked_Table; the Apex action flattens it into this render-time payload so the widget binds with plain forEach only (no dynamic key access), rendering identically in this preview and in the production HXL runtime. The same card serves opportunity-prioritizer, client-portfolio-analysis, contact-outreach-advisor, replanifier-semaine-prochaine, commercial-portfolio-review, urgent-claims-processing. A reference snapshot — illustrative values.
